jobs.title: Healthcare Advocate
jobs.pay: $50,000+ (starts at $50,000; varies by experience and location)
highlights: Own complex medical billing and insurance cases from AI handoff through resolution
Contact payers and providers to fix claims, billing errors, eligibility, and prior-auth issues
Help shape playbooks at a seed-stage advocacy startup
jobs.headsUp: Requires 2+ years of recent (last 2–3 years) patient advocacy, medical billing, health insurance, revenue cycle, or claims resolution experience. Schedule is 40 hours between 7am–9pm ET, with optional weekend shifts.

jobs.title: Eligibility Specialist (Contract)
highlights: Verify insurance coverage, benefits, and eligibility in Athena and payer portals
Track pre-authorizations and coordination of benefits to prevent denials
Work with billing and patients to clear eligibility holds
jobs.headsUp: 1099 contractor role with no company benefits. Requires 2+ years of eligibility/insurance verification, including major commercial plans across multiple states in a telehealth model, plus Athena or similar EHR experience.

jobs.title: Patient Service Representative — Billing
highlights: Handle patient billing and insurance questions in Zendesk
Help verify coverage before telehealth visits and explain financial responsibility
Includes health benefits, PTO, a company laptop, and a work-from-home stipend
jobs.headsUp: Billing experience is preferred, not required, but the posting asks for 2–5 years of patient/customer experience plus 2 years each of Zendesk, an EMR (Athena preferred), and Google Workspace. Shifts are Mon–Fri 9:00am–5:30pm or 1:00pm–9:30pm Chicago time.

jobs.title: Revenue Cycle Specialist (Contract)
highlights: Work Athena claim-hold and denial queues and follow up with payers
Handle patient billing questions, payment plans, and AR follow-up
Partner with clinical and credentialing teams to release held claims
jobs.headsUp: This is a 3-month 1099 contract with no benefits. It asks for 2–3+ years of medical billing/RCM and patient/insurance AR, plus hands-on Athena experience.

jobs.title: RCM Analyst
jobs.location: Remote (US, excluding AK, CA, CO, NY, and WA; Texas is eligible)
highlights: Build and submit clean claims to payers and TPAs for infusion treatments
Post payments and reconcile ERA/EOBs
Use an AI-assisted billing platform to review invoices and flag process gaps
jobs.headsUp: Requires 2+ years in medical billing, claims, or revenue cycle, plus working knowledge of HCPCS (especially J-codes), CPT, and ICD-10. Texas residents are eligible; AK, CA, CO, NY, and WA are excluded.

jobs.title: Care Operations Associate
highlights: Run benefit eligibility checks and keep coverage status current
Manage prior authorizations end to end across payers and specialty pharmacy partners
Chase missing documents and orders with provider offices so treatment is not delayed
jobs.headsUp: Requires 2+ years in a healthcare administrative or operations role supporting prior authorization or eligibility verification, and you must be able to work Central Time business hours.

jobs.title: Member Intake Coordinator
highlights: High-volume outbound intake: 80–100+ daily touchpoints by phone, SMS, and email
Own the member relationship from first outreach through handoff to the Care team
Healthcare or clinical experience is preferred, not required
jobs.headsUp: This is a high-volume outbound role, not a quiet back-office queue. You must be available 10am–6pm Pacific Time (12pm–8pm Chicago time). Prior healthcare experience is preferred only.

jobs.title: Sr. Credentialing & Enrollment Specialist
highlights: Enroll providers with regional and national payers and support new payer launches
Guide providers through credentialing and enrollment steps
Document and improve processes for a remote-first mental health company
jobs.headsUp: Requires 3+ years working with or for health plans, networks, or CVOs, and 2+ years enrolling providers with regional or national payers. This is payer enrollment work, not claims adjudication.

jobs.title: Senior Operations Associate
highlights: Build and run scalable operations workflows that support patients, providers, and payers
Work at the intersection of operations, product, and data
Headway automates credentialing, claims, and payment reconciliation for therapists
jobs.headsUp: This is a process/product operations role, not a classic claims or member-services queue. Pay spans a wide range; the posting does not require prior clinical work, but healthcare-ops exposure helps.

jobs.title: Medical Coding & Billing Specialist
highlights: Submit clean claims with accurate CPT, HCPCS, and ICD-10 codes
Blend coding review with billing follow-up to reduce denials
Support documentation improvements with providers and partner operations
jobs.headsUp: A current CPC certification through AAPC is required and will be verified before an offer. This will not be a fit without that credential.

jobs.title: Insurance Follow-Up Specialist
jobs.location: Remote (US); optional hybrid in Brentwood, TN
highlights: Resolve 50–100 insurance denials a day and work payer portals and clearinghouses
Follow up on Medicare specialty-drug coverage and commercial claims
Full-time role with benefits; BCBS Texas experience is called out as a plus
jobs.headsUp: Requires 5+ years in healthcare billing, claims, or insurance follow-up, plus ICD-10/CPT/HCPCS knowledge and Medicare collections experience. This is a high-volume denial queue, Monday–Friday standard business hours.

jobs.title: Client Outreach Specialist
highlights: Engage people seeking mental health care and help them start treatment
Act as a trusted advisor, not just a scheduler, through the intake path
Fixed weekday schedule with a clearly posted salary range
jobs.headsUp: This is proactive outreach and conversion, closer to member intake than claims or billing. The schedule is fixed 9am–5pm Pacific Time (11am–7pm Chicago time). Prior healthcare experience is not required.

jobs.title: Director of Payor Relations
highlights: Own payer relationships, contracts, negotiations, and fee schedules for a regional clinic portfolio
Translate reimbursement terms into guidance for revenue cycle, finance, credentialing, and operations
Senior individual-contributor role across a 70+ clinic, multi-state network
jobs.headsUp: This is payer contracting and reimbursement strategy, not claims processing. Pay is not posted and the level implies senior healthcare-network experience. There are also clinic sites in the Houston area, but this posting is remote US.
